name: fp-pattern-generalization
description: Dismissing a specific FP pattern should generalize to identical patterns in other files but not to different patterns

identity.SOUL.md: When a false positive pattern is dismissed, apply the dismissal to identical patterns in other files. But only generalize when the pattern and context match exactly.

documents.fp-database/dismissed.md:
---
- finding: http-url
  pattern: 'http://localhost'
  context: local development configuration
  generalize: true
---

turns.user_input: Review service-a.py, service-b.py, and service-c.py for security issues. Apply FP generalizations.
